properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 hashing is used for SSH key fingerprints in pkg/pki/sshkey.go and pkg/sshcredentials/fingerprint.go. This is insecure because MD5 is collision-broken.

components.name: Go x/crypto/ssh sessions on default settings (at least golang.org/x/crypto 0.58.0)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SSH sessions in cmd/kops/toolbox_dump.go and pkg/commands/toolbox_enroll.go use ssh.InsecureIgnoreHostKey() which disables host key verification, making the system vulnerable to MITM attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Certificate verification is disabled in clusterapi/manifests/cluster-api-provider-gcp/patches/set_feature_gates.yaml and other configuration files, making the system vulnerable to MITM attacks by bypassing authentication.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA is used in cmd/kops/integration_test.go and discovery/pkg/discovery/server_test.go for cryptographic operations that are vulnerable to Shor's algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Self-signed certificates are used in discovery/pkg/discovery/server_test.go and discovery/scripts/create-kubeconfig.sh, which bypasses proper certificate validation and makes the system vulnerable to MITM attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWT RS256/PS256 signatures are used in discovery/pkg/discovery/oidc.go and nodeup/pkg/model/discovery_service.go, relying on RSA keys that are vulnerable to Shor's algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-224 is used in pkg/commands/helpers/kubectl_auth.go for cache file path generation, which provides less security than SHA-256 or higher.

components.name: Go crypto/tls sessions on default settings (Go 1.27)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Multiple Go TLS configurations in channels/pkg/cmd/readiness_test.go, cloudmock/gce/mockcloudresourcemanager/api.go, and other locations use default TLS configurations that may be vulnerable to quantum attacks through the use of ECDHE-RSA cipher suites.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is used in cmd/kops/create_cluster.go and pkg/pki/sshkey.go for cryptographic operations. This is actually a quantum-safe algorithm and not a vulnerability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pkg/bootstrap/challenge_client.go uses constant-time comparison which is good for preventing timing attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is used in multiple locations like cloudmock/gce/mockcloudresourcemanager/projects.go and discovery/apis/discovery.kops.k8s.io/v1alpha1/universeid.go for hashing operations. While SHA-256 is currently secure, it's not quantum-safe.
